facts.claim: Persons claiming adverse rights to the Russian Quartz Mine must file their claims with the Register of the United States Land Office at Bodie.
facts.quote: Any and all persons claiming adversely ... are required to file their adverse claims with the Register of the United States Land Office at Bodie.

facts.claim: The Gold and Silver Mining Company filed an application for a patent covering 1500 linear feet of the Ma Quartz Mine vein that bears gold and silver.
facts.quote: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN ... filed its application for a patent for 1500 linear feet of the Ma Quartz Mine or vein bearing gold and silver.
